assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) is the procedure in question
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
The clinical indication note explicitly supports that this procedure is required to capture arrhythmic events
The procedure directly addresses the symptoms documented in the indication
